artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is nonsensical and malformed, characteristic of AI generation failing to render legible typography. It mimics the structure of text but lacks coherent characters.

The buttons below the screen lack logical mechanical structure. They appear melted into each other, with inconsistent depths and shapes that do not correspond to functional physical buttons. The central navigation cluster is particularly distorted and asymmetrical.
The skin texture on the fingers holding the device is overly smooth and plasticky, lacking fine pore details. The boundary between the thumb and the device casing shows slight bleeding/blurring.
The vertical edges of the device waver slightly and do not maintain perfect straightness, suggesting minor geometric instability in the generation process.
